verdict.rationale: 2FAS explicitly states in its machine-readable pricing/docs that 2FAS Auth has 'no advertising, no telemetry,' meaning tracking is absent by design rather than requiring opt-out, and the product is positioned as local-first/open-source, reinforcing a privacy-first posture. Missing for 10: no explicit dedicated privacy-settings toggle documentation, and no independent audit confirming zero telemetry across 2FAS Pass as well as Auth.
